judged_text: create_table :topic_embeds, force: true bakes a DROP TABLE IF EXISTS into the migration, so once the table holds production data any re-run silently destroys the embed_url-to-topic mapping. After this ships, a re-run triggered by a schema_migrations/restore mismatch drops every topic_embeds row; TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed then returns nil for known URLs, so the next retrieve/poll re-imports each article and creates a duplicate topic while the original topic and its replies remain on the forum, doubling content until the mapping is manually rebuilt.

adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `db/migrate/20131217174004_create_topic_embeds.rb` with `create_table :topic_embeds, force: true`. In Rails migrations, `force: true` will drop an existing table before creating it, which would destroy all `topic_embeds` rows if the migration is ever re-run against an environment where the table already exists. Since `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed` relies on that table for URL→topic mapping, losing rows would break lookups and could lead to re-import/duplicate topic creation on subsequent retrieve/poll operations.
